description: "DNA / cDNA / CDS / protein sequence of [gene]" / "FASTA for [Ensembl ID]" / "get sequence of [transcript]" — sequence by Ensembl stable ID. Type defaults to "genomic"; pass "cdna", "cds", or "protein" for processed forms. Use for sequence retrieval in primer design, variant analysis, or downstream sequence tools.

assembly.description: Human genome build: "GRCh38" (the default) or "GRCh37" (= hg19). Coordinates you pass and coordinates you get back are both in this build. Older variant lists, spreadsheets and published tables are usually GRCh37.
